CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2547 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 71a577c96be311326cc93e3044d8dd9907a21694. Bus nonce: 2abb7208f909844fc3bd5673f1060372. Never send push notifications.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 71a577c96be311326cc93e3044d8dd9907a21694`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 71a577c96be311326cc93e3044d8dd9907a21694` or `Fix review: blocked 71a577c96be311326cc93e3044d8dd9907a21694 <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 2abb7208f909844fc3bd5673f1060372`; put the evidence in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `71a577c96be311326cc93e3044d8dd9907a21694` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2547 71a577c96be311326cc93e3044d8dd9907a21694") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2547-2abb7208`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Re-review of PR #2547 (R10-TICK-OWED-LEVEL, branch fix/r10-tick-owed-level) at head 71a577c9, the merge train's recarry of the reviewed head 90bab078 (merge verdict, comment 6322975634). The recarry hit a real conflict in tests/closures.json, resolved by the LEDGER-MERGE driver, so app_approve --carry refuses: the branch's own diff differs. Focus: (1) git diff 90bab078...71a577c9 restricted to what the branch itself changes vs what main brought (three-dot from merge bases); verify the closures.json resolution keeps BOTH main's entries and the branch's, introduces nothing else, and that tests/entities.py and closure checks pass at this head (CI check-runs; do not derive closures off Linux); (2) re-confirm the prior merge verdict's mutation proof still kills at this head (one representative mutant per arm suffices if the code files are byte-identical to 90bab078 - show git diff 90bab078 71a577c9 -- <code paths> is empty); (3) every red check at this head answered in ## Red checks (nightly-status grades main); merge-tree vs current origin/main clean. Standing rule 19: every observation ends with `Carry: <GROUP>` (a group on origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster), `Carry: #<issue>` or `Carry: dismissed: <reason of two or more words>`, each ending (item <id>); carry_audit.py --roster-ref origin/handoff/audit-r10-roster check must show 0 unrouted. Keep ev/ small (no outputs over ~50 KB). Follow dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md. First line `Fix review: merge <head>` or blocked.
